detail.body:
- [ ] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

# What does this PR do?
Independent fixes collected while developing chunk-wise CUDA graphs (#5258); none depends on that feature.

- **Padding mask under SP + MTP** (`gpt_model.py`, `hybrid_model.py`): the decoder gets the sequence-parallel-scattered padding mask, the post-process keeps the caller's full-length mask (MTP rolls it with `input_ids`/`position_ids`; MoE layers re-align it themselves). Fixes PP1 + SP + MTP + packed sequences: `_roll_tensors_packed_seq: All packed CP1 tensors must have the same sequence length`.
- **KDA under CUDA graph capture** (`kda.py`): skip the `torch.equal(cu_seqlens_q, cu_seqlens_kv)` host sync while a stream is capturing, as GDN already does; the boundaries were validated in the eager warm-up.
- **Batch dict aliasing** (`data_schedule.py`): work on a shallow copy of the iterator's batch. The per-rank slicing rebinds entries in place, and replay paths (`RerunDataIterator`, the PagedStashRunner dropless retry) serve the same dict objects again expecting the pre-slice tensors.
- **CUDA context on the recompute thread** (`utils.with_current_cuda_device`, used by `tensor_parallel.checkpoint` and `te_checkpoint`): the recompute runs on the autograd worker thread; kernels launched through the CUDA driver directly (cuTile in the fused mHC kernels) need a current context there, which torch only creates lazily (`Failed to launch cuTile kernel: invalid device context`).
- **HybridModel + `--cross-entropy-fusion-impl linear`**: output layer is `LinearCrossEntropyModule`, same fused linear + CE branch as GPTModel.
- **Fine-grained offload NUMA hint** (`training.py`): a failing `set_ideal_affinity_for_current_gpu` warns per rank instead of aborting (fails when the job's cgroup holds no CPU of the GPU's socket).
- `fp8_utils._get_custom_recipe`: error message as plain string literals (black 26 rewraps the triple-quoted string with trailing blanks in any PR touching the file).

Validation: GB200, 4 ranks. `test_gpt_model.py`, `test_hybrid_model.py`, `test_kda.py`, `test_sequence_packing.py`, `test_random.py`, `test_fp8_utils.py` give the same results as pristine dev (remaining failures are missing MambaSSM and 8-rank-only cases). The PP1+SP+MTP fix was exercised end to end on a DSv3-shaped GPT proxy (TP2 PP1 EP2 SP, THD packing, MTP) in #5258.

:warning: For major changes (either in lines of code or in its impact), please make sure to first share a design doc with the team. If you're unsure what's the best way to do so, contact @NVIDIA/mcore-oncall.

## Issue tracking

For PRs from open-source community contributors:

- **New features**: a linked issue is **required**. Please open a [feature request](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/issues/new?template=feature_request.md) and reference it here before submitting the PR.
- **Small updates (bug fixes, minor improvements)**: a linked issue is **recommended** and will accelerate the PR review process.

Linked issue: <!-- e.g. Fixes #1234 / Related to #1234 -->

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [ ] I have added relevant unit tests
- [ ] I have added relevant functional tests
- [ ] If this PR adds or changes a GPU kernel (Triton, `jit_fuser`/`torch.compile`, CUDA extension, TE or external-library dispatch, or a scatter/index accumulation), I have added or updated its bit-exact determinism test and registered it in `tests/unit_tests/determinism/kernels/manifest.py` ([guide](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/docs/developer/determinism/testing.md))
- [ ] I have added proper typing to my code [Typing guidelines](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html)
- [ ] I have added relevant documentation
- [ ] I have run the [autoformatter.sh](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/tools/autoformat.sh) on my PR

### Code review

Feel free to message or comment @NVIDIA/mcore-oncall to help accelerate your merge into main. The less complex your PR is, the faster it will be approved and merged!

All PRs start as **draft**. If you open a non-draft PR, it will be automatically converted to draft.

#### Step 1: Mark PR as "Ready for Review"

1. When your PR is ready, click **Ready for Review**.
2. An oncall reviewer is auto-assigned and expert reviewers are notified based on your changes.
   - Some PRs may jump straight to step 2. This is determined by `.github/CODEOWNERS`.

:warning: Only mark as ready once merge-conflicts are resolved and the CI is passing.
Final Review might get declined if these requirements are not fulfilled.

#### Step 2: Final Review

For PRs that change `megatron/core`, once all expert reviewers have approved, the `Final Review` label is applied **automatically** and final reviewers are assigned.

For PRs outside `megatron/core`, this step is skipped.

#### Step 3: Approved

Once all required reviewers have approved, the `Approved` label is applied **automatically**.

### Merge

Any member of [mcore-engineers](https://github.com/orgs/NVIDIA/teams/mcore-engineers) will be able to merge your PR.

+def with_current_cuda_device(forward_func):
+    """Wrap a checkpointed function so its recompute runs with a current CUDA context.
+
+    The recompute runs on the autograd engine's worker thread. Kernel runtimes that launch through
+    the CUDA driver directly (cuTile in the fused mHC kernels) need a current context on that

+                torch.cuda.set_device(arg.device)

inline_comments.body:
**[IMPORTANT Correctness]** The fused linear-CE branch silently drops muP output scaling on HybridModel.

**Failure.** HybridModel supports muP: see the `init_method` choice at L402-406 and `scale_logits_fn=self._scale_logits if self.config.use_mup else None` at L754.

With `--use-mup` and `mup_base_hidden_size != hidden_size`, `TransformerConfig.__post_init__` sets `mup_output_mult = 1 / width_mult` ([transformer_config.py#L3266-L3269](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/5d65aad46dd168681976f828afe175e729e7ba0e/megatron/core/transformer/transformer_config.py#L3266-L3269)).

Adding `--cross-entropy-loss-fusion --cross-entropy-fusion-impl linear` now takes this branch:
- It returns the loss straight from `output_layer` and never applies `_scale_logits` ([language_module.py#L309-L326](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/5d65aad46dd168681976f828afe175e729e7ba0e/megatron/core/models/common/language_module/language_module.py#L309-L326)).
- The MTP fused branch also ignores `scale_logits_fn` ([multi_token_prediction.py#L1801-L1820](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/5d65aad46dd168681976f828afe175e729e7ba0e/megatron/core/transformer/multi_token_prediction.py#L1801-L1820)).

Example: hidden 4096 with base 1024 gives width_mult 4. Loss and gradients are then computed on logits 4× larger than the muP model defines. Training runs without error, but transferred hyperparameters no longer hold.

Before this PR, the combination failed loudly on HybridModel: `ColumnParallelLinear` has no `output_cross_entropy_loss`, and `compute_language_model_loss` has no `linear` branch. I found no guard in `TransformerConfig` or `arguments.py`. Expected behavior: either apply the scaling or reject the combination.

**Correction.** The smallest complete fix is to reject the combination in `HybridModel.__init__`, right after the `output_layer` construction (after L413). Neither the main-loss nor the MTP fused path can apply the scaling as written.
```python
        if (
            config.use_mup
            and config.mup_output_mult != 1.0
            and config.cross_entropy_loss_fusion
            and config.cross_entropy_fusion_impl == "linear"
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "cross_entropy_fusion_impl='linear' does not apply muP output scaling "
                f"(mup_output_mult={config.mup_output_mult}); use 'native' or 'te' with use_mup."
            )
```
Also update the comment at L787-789.

Invariant: when `use_mup` is set and `mup_output_mult != 1.0`, the loss must be computed on `logits * mup_output_mult`.

An exact alternative is to feed `hidden_states * mup_output_mult` to the fused call, both here and in `process_mtp_loss`. Because `bias=False`, this gives the same logits and gradients. It requires passing the multiplier into `process_mtp_loss`.

GPTModel has the same gap, which predates this PR. Putting the check in `TransformerConfig.__post_init__` would cover both models, but it changes GPT behavior and is optional here.

**Preservation.** These cases must keep working:
- muP with the `native`/`te` impl, or with no fusion: L798-801 and `scale_logits_fn` in MTP still scale.
- Linear fusion without muP, or with `mup_output_mult == 1.0` (width_mult 1): must still take the fused branch.
- Inference and `labels is None` paths: unchanged.

**Acceptance.** These are proposed tests; I have not run them. Add them to `tests/unit_tests/models/test_hybrid_model.py`.
1. Build a HybridModel with `use_mup=True, mup_base_hidden_size=hidden_size // 2, cross_entropy_loss_fusion=True, cross_entropy_fusion_impl="linear"`. Expect `ValueError`.
2. Build the same model with `use_mup=False`. Construction should succeed. `forward(..., labels=labels)` should return a loss with the same shape as the `native`-impl loss for identical weights, and close to it. Run this on hardware that supports the linear CE kernel.
3. Existing muP Hybrid tests that use the default impl should pass unchanged.

<!-- nemo-ci-review-impact:v1 ceiling=moderate -->

## Summary

This is a broad, strict review of the whole PR (one commit, `5d65aad`). I inspected all 9 changed files and traced the directly affected callers: the MTP roll/loss path, MoE padding-mask re-alignment, the checkpoint/recompute paths, and the sequence-packing batch consumers.

**Findings:** 0 CRITICAL, 1 IMPORTANT, 1 SUGGESTION. Both are inline.

- **[IMPORTANT Correctness]** In [hybrid_model.py#L781-L796](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/5d65aad46dd168681976f828afe175e729e7ba0e/megatron/core/models/hybrid/hybrid_model.py#L781-L796), the new fused linear+CE branch lets `--use-mup` + `--cross-entropy-fusion-impl linear` train **silently** without muP output scaling. The main-loss path skips `_scale_logits`, and the MTP path skips `scale_logits_fn`. Before this PR, that combination failed loudly on HybridModel. Fix: reject the combination, or apply the scaling.
- **[SUGGESTION Style]** The comment at [kda.py#L657-L659](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/5d65aad46dd168681976f828afe175e729e7ba0e/megatron/core/ssm/gated_delta_net/kda.py#L657-L659) says "same guard as GatedDeltaNet". GatedDeltaNet has no such guard: [gdn.py#L210-L213](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/5d65aad46dd168681976f828afe175e729e7ba0e/megatron/core/ssm/gated_delta_net/gdn.py#L210-L213) still calls `torch.equal` with no check.

**Checked, no findings:**
- **Padding-mask split** ([gpt_model.py#L595-L627](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/5d65aad46dd168681976f828afe175e729e7ba0e/megatron/core/models/gpt/gpt_model.py#L595-L627), [hybrid_model.py#L540-L578](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/5d65aad46dd168681976f828afe175e729e7ba0e/megatron/core/models/hybrid/hybrid_model.py#L540-L578)):
  - The decoder gets the sequence-parallel-scattered mask.
  - MTP `prefetch_halos` and `self.mtp(...)` get the full-length mask, so it rolls with `input_ids`/`position_ids` at the same length.
  - MoE layers scatter the full mask themselves.
  - The fine-grained a2a schedule path is unchanged, and it already rejects MTP + packed sequences.
- **`LinearCrossEntropyModule` swap:** it subclasses `ColumnParallelLinear` and adds no parameters, so state-dict and checkpoint keys are unchanged. The existing fused MTP branch in `process_mtp_loss` now works on Hybrid; before, it called `output_cross_entropy_loss=` on a plain `ColumnParallelLinear`.
- **Shallow copy in `data_schedule.py`:** later code only rebinds dict entries (`.view`, `masked_fill`, CP slicing). The iterator's original tensors stay intact for replay.
- **`with_current_cuda_device`:** in `tensor_parallel.checkpoint` it is applied after the graph warmup/capture bypass, and it also wraps the `te_checkpoint` forward. `set_device` on the first CUDA argument causes no harm when it repeats.
- **`training.py` affinity `try/except`:** `os` and `torch` are imported, and `torch.distributed` is initialized at that point. A failure now degrades to a warning on each rank.
- **`fp8_utils` message:** the content is unchanged; only the whitespace differs.

**Risk:** low to moderate. The fixes are small and well scoped. The one material risk is the newly reachable silent muP mis-scaling on HybridModel. None of the fixes adds a regression test (the PR checklist boxes are unchecked). The IMPORTANT finding proposes minimal tests for the Hybrid linear-CE path.
